summary: Iteration 3 full test pass (backend pytest 13 new tests + 16 regression tests, plus frontend E2E on the public preview URL). Backend: /api/config returns llm_mode=deepseek, is_mocked=false, email_enabled=true, digest_email=workspace67676752@gmail.com, digest_schedule='sun 20:00 UTC'; POST /api/lectures/{id}/glossary returned 14 well-formed terms (term/translation/definition, Cyrillic translations, terms literally present in transcript) and persisted them on the lecture (verified via GET); 404 for unknown lecture and 400 for empty transcript; GET /api/glossary/all returns deduped, alphabetically sorted terms with lecture_id/lecture_title; GET /api/digest/preview returns subject starting with 'upsidestudy' + full HTML + int stats; POST /api/digest/send (empty JSON body and explicit {to}) returned 200 with ok/email_id/to; PATCH /api/lectures/{id}/transcript append=true appends + persists duration_sec, append=false replaces, 404 for unknown id. Delete cascade of review_items (iteration-2 minor bug) is fixed; _norm() Cyrillic bug is fixed. Frontend: 5 sidebar nav items all present and SPA-navigable, no ЗАГЛУШКА badge, engine shows 'DeepSeek · Resend'; theme toggle flips html[data-theme] light<->dark, changes computed colors, persists in localStorage 'palimpsest-theme' across reload; automated contrast scan on /, /library, /review, /digest and /lecture/:id in dark mode found no low-contrast (<2.0) text. /record shows all 5 modes; phone mode blocks without title (toast 'Сначала укажите название лекции.', no QR), with title renders QR SVG, phone-link -> /m/{id}, and the live pane picked up a simulated appended chunk within ~3s. /m/{id} renders lecture title, mobile-start and mobile-transcript. /digest renders 4 stat tiles + iframe preview (h1 'Что произошло на этой неделе'), Отправить себе -> POST /digest/send 200 + success toast with recipient, Скопировать HTML -> success toast (needs clipboard permission). Lecture page: Глоссарий/Обновить глоссарий button generates terms (POST 200, toast 'Готово · 14 терминов.'), 14 glossary cards render, 15 dashed-underlined .term-hl spans in transcript with title=translation and click opens term-popover showing term + translation + Russian definition; clicking popover closes it. No critical bugs found; 3 minor UX issues below.

minor.issue: Requires a JSON body: a POST with no body at all returns 422 (DigestSend model param has no default). Frontend always sends {} so this is not user-visible, but for curl/cron-style callers give the body a default: `body: DigestSend = DigestSend()`.

The QR flow creates the lecture as soon as 'Показать QR' is clicked. If the user never records, an empty-transcript lecture stays in the library/digest forever. Consider cleaning up empty phone lectures or creating the lecture only on the first chunk.

ui_bugs.issue: For an unknown lecture id the page shows 'Загрузка…' forever and still leaves 'Начать запись' enabled, so a user can record into a nonexistent lecture and every 4s PATCH silently 404s (only console errors). Show a terminal error state and disable mobile-start when the lecture failed to load. Also the 'Лекция не найдена.' toast fires twice (StrictMode double effect).

issues: MobileRecordPage does not call useTheme, so html[data-theme] is never set there; a user with dark theme selected gets a light page on the phone (and page uses --paper defaults). Add useTheme() (or set the attribute in index.js) so the theme applies on non-AppShell routes.

action_items: MobileRecordPage: handle lecture-not-found (disable start button, show error state) and de-duplicate the error toast.
Apply the persisted theme on the /m/:id route (useTheme or set data-theme globally in index.js).
Optional: give DigestSend a default so POST /api/digest/send works without a body; consider not creating an empty lecture until the phone sends the first chunk.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 875 lines — split into routers (lectures, tests/grading, review, glossary, digest, scheduler) before it grows further.
_scheduled_digest calls the route handler digest_send() directly; extract a plain async send_digest(recipient) helper so the cron path doesn't depend on FastAPI request-model plumbing.
POST /api/review/seed-now is still an ungated debug endpoint that rewrites all review scheduling — gate it behind an env flag.
Glossary generation has no cap/guard on repeated calls; each click re-hits the LLM and overwrites terms (acceptable, but consider a spinner-lock/idempotency note).

Glossary term highlighting relies on the LLM returning exact transcript surface forms; if the model returns lemmas the highlight silently disappears. Consider a fuzzy/stem fallback in TranscriptWithTerms.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13 passed, 1 skipped by design; 16/16 regression passed)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all new flows work; 1 medium mobile-route edge case + 1 theme scoping gap)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST_ lectures (TEST_Glossary UI Seed with a 14-term glossary, TEST_Phone QR Session, TEST_Append/Replace/Empty). DB left with the original 3 lectures: 'Test SR flow', 'Supply and Demand E2E', 'Photosynthesis Basics'. Two real digest emails were sent to workspace67676752@gmail.com during testing.
test_credentials: None required — /app/memory/test_credentials.md states the app is single-user with no auth (confirmed, all routes public).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable suites: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (iterations 1-2: config, summary, test gen, transcription, spaced repetition) and /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (config extras, transcript append, glossary, digest). Use /app/backend/tests/seed_iter3.py to create a lecture with a real glossary for UI testing (prints the lecture id). Note pytest.ini uses -n 2 --dist loadscope. Clipboard tests need page.context.grant_permissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write']). Sonner toasts auto-dismiss ~4s — poll for them instead of a long sleep. Digest send hits the real Resend API and sends real email; avoid spamming.
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile route issue: MobileRecordPage's initial fetch failure only toasts and leaves lec=null, while the record button state depends solely on `supported`; no error flag gates the UI. Theme issue: data-theme is set exclusively inside AppShell via useTheme, and /m/:id is rendered outside AppShell, so the attribute is never applied there.
